component.description: Multi-agent memory system: six memory stores (core, episodic, semantic, procedural, resource, knowledge vault), each written by an LLM-driven sub-agent under a meta agent, behind a FastAPI REST server on PostgreSQL + pgvector with a thin REST client.

findings.summary: PromptTokensDetails.audio_tokens is a non-Optional int, so every llama.cpp completion (which sends usage.prompt_tokens_details.audio_tokens: null) fails validation; topic extraction and every memory-agent step fail against a llama.cpp backend.

embedding_model() builds the llama_index OpenAIEmbedding without config.embedding_model, so an OpenAI-compatible embedding server is asked for text-embedding-ada-002; build_embeddings_for_memory: false skips the init check but not the semantic and episodic memory inserts.

The README quick start calls the client's async methods without await; run as written it only creates coroutines. samples/run_client.py at main awaits them and is not affected (the first pass said otherwise).

samples/generate_demo_api_key.py calls OrganizationManager/ClientManager methods without await; they are async at main. The first pass's as-shipped run output was not retained, so this rests on source review. The as-run awaited helper issued the key used by the main runs but printed it to the terminal and is not retained. local-integration/gen_key_main.py is the fixed successor: it writes only to a caller-chosen new 0600 file and was checked with dummy modules, not used for the historical server runs.

add_memory concatenates a string prefix with each dict part of list content, so the README's list-of-parts message shape returns 500. v0.1.6 extends list content as-is, so this is a regression after the tag.
tests/test_search_all_users.py passes config_path= to initialize_meta_agent, which has no such parameter in the same release.
The package description says `pip install mirix-client`; that PyPI project has no files.
tests/README.md describes two test files (18 + 4 tests); the tag ships 14 test_*.py files and pytest collected 193 tests.

blocked.reason: Exists only on main. Its documented prerequisite is an OpenAI API key, and its only profile (evals/configs/mab.yaml) targets api.openai.com for chat, topic extraction and embeddings with build_embeddings_for_memory: true. No cloud key is used on this host. Pointed at local endpoints, its memory writes would hit F2, which the main runs above already show.

verdict.measured: No memory was persisted through MIRIX's documented add/retrieve path against this host's local OpenAI-compatible endpoints at either pin. v0.1.6: F1 fails every local chat completion; with embeddings on, F2 fails agent initialization. main@8cb06a62: F1 is fixed and the local model produced a well-formed topic, tool call and memory object, but the semantic and episodic inserts fail on F2; the README quick start also hits F3 and F5. The pinned tag's own suite: 88 passed, 1 failed, 88 skipped, 16 errors (F6 once the API key is set).
blockers: upstream eval harness requires a cloud key and is main-only
verdict.layer_decision: Not made here. The foundation durable-memory layer's verdict is re-recorded by its own verdict wave (tools/sota-convergence/record_verdicts.py); this trial supplies measured results and blockers only.
verdict.retrial_trigger: A MIRIX release that forwards embedding_model for OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoints (F2) and parses a null audio_tokens (F1, fixed on main), then the same local-endpoint add/retrieve check plus the upstream LongMemEval-S harness against local endpoints.
